# Security

Stage Manager has Accessibility access to move your windows and updates itself from GitHub,
so a security problem in it matters. Please report one privately, not in a public issue:
use **Report a vulnerability** on the repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/eugene-tea/stage-manager/security/advisories/new).

Say what the problem is, the app and macOS versions, and how to reproduce it.

Only the latest release gets fixes; the app offers each new release itself.
